comments.author: Dana Whitfield
comments.body: App still points at the monolithic table — cutover PR waits on backfill checksum.

content.text: App still points at the monolithic table — cutover PR waits on backfill checksum.
webhook_delivery_logs is a single hot table past 400M rows; vacuum and index maintenance stall writers during peak. Query patterns are almost always time-bounded by created_at.

Migrate to monthly range partitions on created_at, detach partitions older than 90 days to cold storage object dumps, and keep a thin hot parent for the recent window. Completion means dual-write validation for one week, cutover runbook executed in staging then production, and app queries unchanged via the parent table name.
